_doc: Quixel Megascans (Fab, Standard License) used locally. Files are git-ignored (public repo, no redistribution). Put each downloaded 2K texture-set zip from Fab in ~/Downloads (or pass -Downloads) and run Scripts/import_megascans.py: it extracts the listed maps to Content/Art/Raw/Megascans/<id>/ and imports them to /Game/Project/Environments/Megascans/<id>/. AStreetballWorld reads 'targets' at startup: for each material it makes one dynamic instance and sets the texture/scalar parameters, but only when every texture of that target loads; otherwise the material stays procedural.
